bugs_found: transfer() does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float amounts can raise TypeError when subtracting from Decimal balances and may produce inconsistent Receipt.amount types
compound_interest() silently truncates fractional years via int(float(years)), returning incorrect results instead of rejecting or correctly handling partial years
loan_payment() silently truncates non-integer numeric months via int(months), which can undercharge or miscalculate instead of rejecting invalid terms
fx_convert() does not validate that the exchange rate is positive, so zero or negative rates can produce invalid converted amounts
